title: Friday value pick: no clean stock this week (20 Nov 2026)
summary: No value pick this week: all 12 shortlisted stocks, led by FORCEMOT, BLS and EMMVEE, had at least one manipulation flag.
body_md:
**Friday value pick · 20 Nov 2026** · long-term idea, not a swing trade

**No clean stock this week**

21 of 401 Midcap 150 + Smallcap 250 stocks passed the numbers screen. After skipping the last three picks (IndiaMART, Endurance, HBL Engineering), all 12 stocks checked had at least one manipulation flag, so there is no teardown this week.

No pick this week: every shortlisted stock had a manipulation flag, an unfinished check or a promoter score below 6.

**This week's screen** (no promoter score because none was clean)

| # | Stock | Score | Manipulation flags |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | FORCEMOT | 88 | SEBI probe |
| 2 | BLS | 84 | Govt ban, Bulk deals |
| 3 | EMMVEE | 83 | Customs penalty |
| 4 | KPITTECH | 75 | Promoter down, Bulk deals |
| 5 | RAILTEL | 73 | Exchange fines, RPT |
| 6 | KPIL | 72 | Pledge, Promoter down |
| 7 | KARURVYSYA | 68 | RBI fine, Pledge, Promoter down |
| 8 | RRKABEL | 68 | Promoter down |
| 9 | IKS | 67 | SEZ/customs penalty |
| 10 | OLECTRA | 66 | CBI case on promoter, RPT |
| 11 | DOMS | 63 | Promoter down |
| 12 | IGIL | 63 | MCA proceedings, Auditor |

**Numbers screen:** ROCE > 15%, 3-year sales and profit growth > 15%, debt/equity < 0.5, cash flow ≥ 70% of profit, P/E below its own or its industry's median. Any manipulation flag rules a stock out. Promoter score 6+/10 needed. Long-term idea, not a swing trade.

**Runners-up:** none; no stock was clean.

**Why each stock was ruled out**
- **FORCEMOT** (Force Motors Ltd.): Live SEBI insider-trading examination (company disclosure, Feb 2026). https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/FORCEMOTORS_05022026155742_intimation_under_Regulation_30_13_.pdf
- **BLS** (BLS International Services Ltd.): Ministry of External Affairs tender debarment (Oct 2025, later set aside); repeated trading-firm bulk deals. https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/BLS_11102025131404_Intimation_of_Order_of_MEA.pdf and https://www.nseindia.com/api/historicalOR/bulk-block-short-deals?optionType=bulk_deals&symbol=BLS&from=16-10-2025&to=16-10-2026
- **EMMVEE** (Emmvee Photovoltaic Power Ltd.): Customs penalty order incl. a director (Mar 2026). https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/EMMVEE_17032026115451_Regulation_30_stock_exchange_intimation_Custom_Order_17032026.pdf
- **KPITTECH** (KPIT Technologies Ltd.): Promoter holding 38.6%, below 40%; Graviton in 10 bulk deals in a year. https://www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-share-holdings-master?index=equities&symbol=KPITTECH and https://www.nseindia.com/api/historicalOR/bulk-block-short-deals?optionType=bulk_deals&symbol=KPITTECH&from=16-10-2025&to=16-10-2026
- **RAILTEL** (Railtel Corporation Of India Ltd.): Exchange fines for board composition; Indian Railways related-party sales about 13% of revenue. https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/RAILTEL_27082026225752_Intimation_Penalty_Fine.pdf and https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ixbrl/INTEGRATED_FILING_INDAS_154945_30042026183427_iXBRL_WEB.html
- **KPIL** (Kalpataru Projects International Ltd.): 31.5% of promoter holding pledged; promoter holding 33.6%, below 40%. https://www.screener.in/company/KPIL/consolidated/
- **KARURVYSYA** (Karur Vysya Bank Ltd.): RBI penalty ₹8.3 lakh (Feb 2025); promoter encumbrance; promoter holding 2.07%. https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=59706 and https://www.nseindia.com/api/corporate-pledgedata?index=equities&symbol=KARURVYSYA
- **RRKABEL** (R R Kabel Ltd.): Promoter holding fell 2.43 points in a year (61.76% to 59.33%). https://www.screener.in/company/RRKABEL/consolidated/
- **IKS** (Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Ltd.): SEEPZ SEZ and customs penalty orders on the company and a subsidiary (2025–26). https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/IKSSHEETAL_12032026201143_StockExch_12March2026_SEEPZOder.pdf and https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ShubhamIKS_02082025190815_AquityCustomsPenalty01082025.pdf
- **OLECTRA** (Olectra Greentech Ltd.): CBI FIR naming promoter company MEIL (2024); ₹300 cr undertaking backing a MEIL-group firm. https://www.business-standard.com/companies/news/cbi-fir-against-second-biggest-electoral-bond-buyer-megha-engineering-124041300486_1.html and https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/OLECTRA_08112025193040_DisclosureMSR08112025.pdf
- **DOMS** (DOMS Industries Ltd.): Promoter holding fell 7 points in a year (70.38% to 63.38%) after F.I.L.A.'s Jun 2026 block sale. https://www.screener.in/company/DOMS/consolidated/
- **IGIL** (International Gemological Institute Ltd.): Ministry of Corporate Affairs proceedings over related-party violations (Sep 2024, compounding pending at IPO); statutory auditor resigned mid-term in 2023. https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/dec-2024/1734587659943.pdf and https://investor.igi.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/08/FY-2023-Standalone.pdf

All 12 stocks were screened in earlier weeks, so every flag carries over from the 16 Oct to 13 Nov screens: each one is a dated event, or a shareholding pattern that has not been updated since, still inside its look-back window. R R Kabel is back on the numbers screen and Aptus Value Housing dropped off it. No stock was new this week, so no fresh manipulation checks were needed.

Research for your own analysis, not investment advice.
